b: Well, just like that, Black Friday 2026 has been and gone... Well, not really. As most of you will know by now, Black Friday is a multi-day event, running from Friday through to Cyber Monday, or Cyber Weekend as some like to call it.

That means the Black Friday guitar deals are still very much in full swing. To make sure you don't miss a single bargain, and as we enter the second day of the sales, I'll be updating this page live through the end of Cyber Monday.

Right now, Guitar Center has discounts of up to 40% on a massive range of guitar gear, with popular models from Fender, Gibson, PRS, Boss, Yamaha, Ibanez, Epiphone, Taylor, and more on sale. Meanwhile, Sweetwater's Black Friday sale offers up to 70% off a huge selection of guitars, amps, pedals, and studio accessories, making it one of the largest sales live right now.
The Guitar World team and I have covered these mammoth sales for years, and we know how fast-moving and chaotic the Cyber Weekend rush can get.

That’s why we’ve launched this live hub to save you the stress and to give you fair warning on the deals that matter. And remember, we're all guitar nerds who test the latest gear year-round, so we know what makes a great product and, crucially, what doesn't.

There is a difference between practice and noodling. Not that there is anything wrong with the latter, but the former can take a little more time to get set up. The JBL Bandbox Solo can help, and it is currently on a Black Friday Sale at Sweetwater with a $50 saving.
Perhaps the ultimate desktop practice tool, it is at its core a diminutive practice amp that covers everything from crystal-clear cleans to soaring leads, but its party trick? Live stem separation.
Connect any Bluetooth device, and it will separate the stems as you stream audio to the Bandbox. Meaning we can isolate a guitar track for learning, or remove it for jamming. Pretty handy.

The JBL Bandbox Solo is a handy tool in a world where streaming is king, and very few people actually own the music they listen to. As well as a capable desktop practice amp with a wide selection of sounds, it takes music from any Bluetooth source and can separate the stems live to create backing tracks to jam along to, or isolate parts to figure out.
A worthwhile tool, currently on a $50 Black Friday discount.View Deal

Its three footswitch setups allow you to change sounds on the fly, and its pedalboard-friendly size makes it well-suited to sitting on the end of a pedalboard. It was already affordable as well, so with this massive saving, it is worth a look for anyone looking to replace their amp.
The IK Multimedia Tonex Pedal was already a bargain at full price. At a 30% discount, it is even more so.
